narrator.speaker: ryan
narrator.instruction: clear, confident storytelling narrator for a manhwa recap channel, steady lively pace, speaks only the given words, no laughing, no whispering, no sighs
narrator.description: An American man about 30 with a vivid, cinematic storytelling voice: clear and engaging, able to turn dramatic or analytical as the story needs, steady pacing that picks up with a little energy in fight scenes
narrator.voice_text: At midnight, four billion people vanished from Earth. They woke up alone, on rafts, in an ocean that never ends. And one of them was about to become number one in the world.

yunjae.desc: Seo Yun-jae, a calm 24-year-old Korean man with short slightly messy black hair, dark brown eyes, a navy blue work jacket with a small orange wrench patch on the chest, a plain gray t-shirt, dark jeans and worn black sneakers

aeliss.desc: Aeliss, an elegant elf woman with long, smooth, straight, sleek silver-white hair that falls flat past her waist, no spikes, no messy strands, long pointed ears, sea-green eyes and a calm sad expression, a flowing teal robe with silver seashell clasps at the shoulders and a seashell belt over a white underdress, long open sleeves, barefoot, holding a branching coral staff topped with a glowing aqua pearl

kaiser.desc: Kaiser, a tall broad-shouldered man around forty with neatly slicked-back smooth black hair going gray at the sides, sharp hazel eyes, a smug confident half-smile, a white dress shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a loose black tie, a brown leather belt, charcoal dress trousers, polished black shoes and a silver watch

haeun.desc: Seo Ha-eun, a cheerful 15-year-old Korean girl with long dark brown hair in a high ponytail and straight bangs, big brown eyes, wearing loose light blue pajamas covered in small white stars and fluffy white slippers

grandma.desc: the small kind Korean grandmother with silver hair in a neat low bun, round wire glasses, a gentle wrinkled smile, a cream cable-knit cardigan over a dark floral blouse, a long navy skirt, white socks and black flat shoes

raft.desc: a tiny square wooden raft only two meters wide, made of four plain rough weathered gray-brown planks lashed together with thick tan rope, none of the planks glowing

panel.desc: a floating translucent glowing blue holographic System window with glowing borders and abstract symbols, no readable text

knight.desc: Ostrel, the tall silent armored knight in polished dark purple-steel plate armor with violet trim, a long dark navy cape and a fully enclosed smooth steel helmet with a narrow glowing blue visor slit, no face and no hair visible, nothing on top of the helmet, a long straight sword

dahye.desc: Yoon Da-hye, a calm capable Korean nurse in her late twenties with smooth dark brown hair in a loose low ponytail, side-swept bangs and a small silver hair clip, brown eyes, teal hospital scrubs with a small blank ID badge over a black long-sleeve shirt and white sneakers

taegu.desc: Bang Tae-gu, a huge hulking muscular Korean man in his late twenties with a very short, flat black buzz cut close to the scalp, a thick neck, a cocky grin and a small scar over one eyebrow, a silver chain necklace, a black sleeveless tank top, gray jogger sweatpants and white sneakers

raft1.desc: the tiny two-meter square raft of four weathered gray-brown planks lashed with thick tan rope, one of the planks smooth dark wood with a soft green glow

raft2.desc: the three-meter square raft of weathered gray planks lashed with tan rope, one smooth dark plank glowing green, a short mast with a small patched cream sail, a wooden storage crate and a fishing rod in a rope holder

raft3.desc: the four-meter square log-framed raft with raised edges, one plank glowing green, a small wooden roof shelter, two rain-catching barrels with cloth funnels, a small iron stove and a patched cream sail

raft4.desc: the small twin-hull wooden catamaran with a flat plank deck, a rope railing, a little wooden cabin with a round window, a white sail, and one dark plank glowing green in the middle of the deck

raft5.desc: the small armored sailing ship with dark wooden hulls reinforced with riveted steel plates, white sails with a faint purple shimmer, a crow's nest, two mounted deck crossbows, a small cabin, and one dark plank glowing green in the center of the deck

raft2_plain.desc: a three-meter square raft of weathered gray planks lashed with tan rope, a short mast with a small patched cream sail, a wooden storage crate and a fishing rod in a rope holder, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft3_plain.desc: a four-meter square log-framed raft with raised edges, a small wooden roof shelter, two rain-catching barrels with cloth funnels, a small iron stove and a patched cream sail, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft4_plain.desc: a small twin-hull wooden catamaran with a flat plank deck, a rope railing, a little wooden cabin with a round window, a white sail, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft5_plain.desc: a small armored sailing ship with dark wooden hulls reinforced with riveted steel plates, white sails with a faint purple shimmer, a crow's nest, two mounted deck crossbows, a small cabin, every deck plank plain with no glow

jiho.desc: Noh Ji-ho, a skinny nervous Korean man in his early twenties with soft, fluffy, messy brown hair (not spiky), round thin-framed glasses, big anxious brown eyes, an oversized gray hoodie, a black backpack, loose dark gray sweatpants and white slip-on sneakers

jiho_vanish.desc: Noh Ji-ho using Vanish: the same skinny young man with soft, fluffy, messy brown hair (not spiky), round glasses, oversized gray hoodie, black backpack, dark gray sweatpants and white slip-ons, but faded and half see-through, with a soft pale blue glow along his edges and tiny drifting blue sparkles around him

pyo.desc: Pyo, a wiry raider in his thirties with a smooth shaved bald head, a thin mustache, a torn black tank top, cargo shorts and a kitchen knife

gil.desc: Gil, a lanky young raider with long, straight, greasy dark hair tied back in a low ponytail (not spiky), a stained yellow raincoat and a coil of rope with a metal hook over his shoulder

hobb.desc: Hobb, a short round cheerful older man with a bushy gray beard, rosy cheeks, a bald head with a gray fringe of hair, small round spectacles, a white apron over a brown vest and a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark brown trousers and worn brown leather boots, holding a wooden ladle

monster.desc: the gigantic shark-like sea monster about twenty meters long, always IN the water: most of its body hidden under the surface, only its head, jaws, dorsal fin or back breaking through the waves with water pouring off it, dark blue-gray armored scales, a pale belly, rows of huge jagged white teeth, small glowing white eyes and faint scars on its snout, no legs, no wings

raft2_covered.desc: the three-meter square raft of weathered gray planks lashed with tan rope, a short mast with a small patched cream sail, a wooden storage crate and a fishing rod in a rope holder, a dark brown cloth draped flat over the middle of the deck, the whole raft dark with no glow anywhere

fennick.desc: Fennick, a wiry weathered shipwright in his forties with a sun-browned face, a short red-brown beard, shaggy shoulder-length red-brown hair tied back with a strip of cloth, a pencil behind one ear, a worn leather tool apron full of chisels and mallets over a rolled-sleeve linen shirt, patched canvas trousers and bare feet

dorran.desc: Dorran Shieldwall, a huge broad-shouldered calm warrior in his fifties, weathered tan skin, short close-cropped iron-gray hair and a short gray beard, a pale scar running across his nose and cheek, steady gray eyes, dented dark steel plate armor over a faded crimson tabard, a huge rectangular steel tower shield nearly as tall as he is with a worn plain crest, a short broad axe at his belt

system.description: An American woman about 30, the voice of an all-knowing game system: analytical and dryly sarcastic, beautiful and smooth with a slightly robotic, precise, synthetic polish, calm even pacing
system.voice_text: Good morning, candidate. You have been summoned to the Drift. Survival odds are low. Please try not to die. It makes the paperwork worse.

setting: Setting: the whole world is one endless open ocean with no land anywhere: no shore, no islands, no trees, no buildings, no ships or boats; people live alone on small flat wooden rafts on the sea. Each named character appears only once
